claim.quote: The T2K experiment has observed electron neutrino appearance in a muon neutrino beam produced 295 km from the Super-Kamiokande detector with a peak energy of 0.6 GeV. A total of 28 electron neutrino events were detected with an energy distribution consistent with an appearance signal, corresponding to a significance of 7.3σ when compared to 4.92 ± 0.55 expected background events.

date.note: arXiv v1 submission date (the T2K news item of 3 December 2013 says the paper had by then been submitted to Physical Review Letters). Published as Phys. Rev. Lett. 112, 061802 (2014).

key_value_text.value: Best-fit sin²(2θ13) = 0.140 (+0.038/−0.032) for normal mass ordering (0.170 (+0.045/−0.037) for inverted), at δCP = 0, assuming |Δm²32| = 2.4×10⁻³ eV² and sin²θ23 = 0.5.

name: T2K observation of electron-neutrino appearance
notes: T2K's own news item of 3 December 2013 (https://t2k-experiment.org/?p=1967) describes the paper as "reporting the definitive observation of electron neutrino appearance in a high-purity muon neutrino beam"; the abstract itself says "The T2K experiment has observed electron neutrino appearance".

significance.quote: corresponding to a significance of 7.3$σ$ when compared to 4.92 $\pm$ 0.55 expected background events
significance.value: 7.3σ (rejection of the background-only expectation of 4.92 ± 0.55 events)

summary.plain: T2K reported observing electron-neutrino appearance in a muon-neutrino beam sent 295 km across Japan to Super-Kamiokande: 28 electron-neutrino events were detected against 4.92 ± 0.55 expected from background, a significance of 7.3σ. The collaboration's own news item calls it the definitive observation of electron neutrino appearance.
summary.technical: 28 νe candidate events at Super-Kamiokande (295 km, peak energy 0.6 GeV) against 4.92 ± 0.55 expected background events: 7.3σ. Best-fit sin²2θ13 = 0.140 (+0.038/−0.032) for normal ordering and 0.170 (+0.045/−0.037) for inverted ordering at δCP = 0, assuming |Δm²32| = 2.4×10⁻³ eV² and sin²θ23 = 0.5; combined with reactor θ13 measurements, some values of δCP are disfavored at the 90% CL.

title: Observation of Electron Neutrino Appearance in a Muon Neutrino Beam

why_it_matters.locator: arXiv:1311.4750, introduction (first paragraph); abstract for the δCP statement
why_it_matters.quote: there has not been an observation of the explicit appearance of a different neutrino flavor from neutrinos of another flavor through neutrino oscillations
why_it_matters.value: The paper's introduction notes that, to date, there had not been an observation of the explicit appearance of a different neutrino flavor from neutrinos of another flavor through neutrino oscillations; the appearance signal depends on θ13 and δCP, and combining with reactor θ13 data the paper finds that some values of δCP are disfavored at the 90% CL.
